svg.text: KALA · SCREW JACK · COMMON GENERAL ARRANGEMENT
Target 2,000 kg / 120 mm stroke · Tr30×4 RH · dimensions mm · 17 October 2026
PRELIMINARY — NOT RELEASED FOR FABRICATION OR VEHICLE LIFTING
SECTION ELEVATION · shown at 60 mm extension
collapsed top 328
raised top 448
HANDLE Ø16 × 500
388 shown
120 travel / 30 turns
230 threaded length
48 thread engagement
Housing Ø70 / Ø56
Bronze nut Ø54 · thread length 48
Flange Ø80 × 8 on support ring Ø90 × 8
Stop collar Ø36 / Ø25.7 × 6 · retention TBD
Integral drive head Ø48 × 28 / Ø17 bore
NSK51305 candidate · Ø25 / Ø52 × 18
Saddle Ø70 × 12 · journal Ø25 / bore Ø25.5
COMMON DESIGN CONTROLS
• Base 200 × 180 × 12; housing top z212.
• Tr30×4 single-start RH; basic root Ø25.5.
• Strength screening uses minimum root Ø25.0.
• Working target 19.62 kN; assumed proof 29.43 kN.
• Nut engagement remains 48 throughout travel.
• Raised screw starts z160; nut thread starts z164.
• Collar top contacts nut-skirt underside at z160.
• Stop clamp/attachment is NOT designed or rated.
• Ø54 nut in Ø56 housing needs fitted location.
• M6 flange screws nominal; fit/preload not released.
• Seat articulation / vehicle interface unresolved.
• Closed height 328 limits vehicle applicability.
BASE PLAN · common envelope
CAD-route details differ: native call build uses editable feature regions; direct script adds gussets and rounded base corners.
Mounting holes / grip details / retention hardware are excluded here. Use each CAD validation and BOM to inspect its actual geometry.
General arrangement only. No dimensional tolerances, weld symbols, fits, heat-treatment process or product rating are established.
